'''Dotswa Ween''' chaired the [[RCLU]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]. On the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] [[22 BBY/Legends|13:4:11]], the chairbeing made an appearance on a talk show called ''[[In the Political Pit]]'' at 1935. Ween appeared alongside [[Actor/Legends|actor]] [[Reridan Reksiss]], [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], and [[Musician/Legends|recording artist]] [[Gaeriala Boosin]]. The event was advertised on that [[Standard day/Legends|day's]] issue of [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News']] [[HoloNet News CoCo District Edition|CoCo District Edition]].<ref name="HNN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dotswa Ween was mentioned in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 51|Volume 531, Issue 51]] of the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]],<ref name="HNN" /> which was released on [[April 11]], [[2002]].<ref name="HNN51 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6401165|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=MattPeriolat|date=2002-04-11|time=6:19 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200305125429/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-13}}</ref> Written from an [[in-universe]] perspective,<ref name="HNN" /> the issue was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]].<ref name="HNN Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref>
